No source of this estimate is connected at all.","how_to_obtain":"Commission a technical spike from engineering: scope the order-path integration, confirm behaviour against the 50 req/sec cap at peak order volume, and produce a sized estimate with a delivery date.","was_searched":false},{"id":"GAP-007","question":"What is the fully loaded cost per delivery of each candidate intervention, including SMS send costs, address-validation integration and run costs, and any AI human-review labour?","impact":"would_change_recommendation","why_it_matters":"Cost per delivery is named the binding constraint, and any proposal that increases it requires finance approval before a pilot may begin. If the decline is driven by a compositional shift (more apartment deliveries, new metros, a carrier change) rather than by any of the three candidate causes, all three interventions could be aimed at the wrong thing.","how_to_obtain":"Ask analytics for a decomposition of the five-quarter decline by segment mix, geography, carrier, and order volume, and reconcile the 91% figure in the objectives document against the metrics series.","was_searched":true},{"id":"GAP-011","question":"What share of delivery exceptions and support contacts would each candidate intervention plausibly address, expressed as an addressable-volume estimate?","impact":"would_change_support_level","why_it_matters":"Ticket counts by category exist, but nobody has mapped categories to interventions or estimated what fraction of each category is actually preventable.
